4 | Estimated Amount Rs. | 440.84999999999997 | including cost Index, 3%Contingencies & 7% DC
5 | History | Central Warehouse Kakkanad is having 27160 MTC (21850 MTC pre- revised) capacity in three units of 21.80 m span with Pre coated GI sheet roofing along with office building, check post, weigh bridge. This centre is situated in the Kinfra Industrial Park in 9.14 Acre land Additional construction (PEB) of 2384 Sqm (25652 sft) (As per LOP No.407/3) having one no. Godown of size 121.64x12.05 and other (Size 44.24 m x23.46 m). The Initial NOC for the existing Godown( Godown No.1,2&3) obtained vide Lr.No.FRS/07/TKRA/8121/2022/SITE Dated: 24.08.2022. and the initial NOC for the new godowns being constructed to be obtained separately. Now installations of Fire system to be executed for the existing Godowns. Accordingly, this estimate has been prepared. The Local bodies are insisting for the installation of fire system as this is a mandatory item as per the local by laws. For the new constructions(2384 sqm ) the AA & ES may be checked from the Approved PR for the same. Hence provision for the new construction is not included in this estimate.
6 | Design & Scope | The RCC Under Ground Sump 150,000 Litre and Overhead Tank of 30,000 Litres capacity as per norms ofthe fire department is proposed. Since the soil found to be having poor bearing capacity, provision for raft foundation is proposed. Pump room should be in level with the sump bottom ( positive suction) and the overhead tank proposed over the pump house with column starting from the bottom foundation. For execution of the Fire system and OH & UG sump, design has to be obtained from consultants.
7 | Specification | : As per CPWD Specifications and as per usual practice
8 | Rate | : As per CPWD- PAR- 2021
9 | Method | : By calling tender ( The fire system work being a specialised work, permission may be given for inviting two tenders ie civil work and fire system works.)
10 | Time | Five months
